description:
SaltyBytes finds real, published recipes from across the web and brings them into your chat, then saves the ones you like to your own SaltyBytes collection so they are ready in the app when you cook.

Ask for something specific, like a gluten-free birthday cake or a 30-minute weeknight salmon, and SaltyBytes searches the open web and returns real recipes with full ingredients, steps, and times, so you can decide before you commit. Paste a recipe link and it extracts the recipe cleanly. Say the word and it saves the recipe to your collection, where it syncs with the SaltyBytes mobile app. You can also look up the recipes you have already saved, all without leaving the conversation.

SaltyBytes only reads and writes your own recipe collection, through a scoped connection you approve and can revoke at any time. A free SaltyBytes account is required.
